feature: An animated icon told as a little story: the trash ricochets off the lid into the can when there is room for it
summary: When the trash is thrown at the open lid, the app now places the hit where the trash's own rebound off the lid carries it into the can, and keeps it moving at speed as it falls instead of stopping in mid-air. It works when the scrap is small next to the can's mouth. When the agent draws a scrap that nearly fills the mouth, which happened in this pass's walk and its test run, it still slides down the lid and over the can's wall. The bar (five of six stories reading as asked) is not met: one of six.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. New window, Icon, then Ask.

evaluate: In the replay of last pass's plan, does the trash coming off the lid and dropping straight in read as a bounce, or does it need a hop up first?
